about_the_game:
Treat yourself to 900 RuneCoins!

This pack contains 900 RuneCoins which can be used to buy in-game goodies at the Marketplace!
Purchase from a huge selection of outfits, animations, titles and pets to help you stand out from the crowd.

Note
· DLC Bundle items are not tradeable or refundable.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac 10.8 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i3+ @ 2.4+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 7xxx +
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required to play, offers in-game purchases. Platforms / devices with 32-bit PowerPC CPUs are officially no longer supported by RuneScape. Starting with MacOS 10.8, Apple supports 64-bit devices, only.
